label: TEST: CX-8 rig and local test stack only. Not an owner decision and not a product default.

WS_DEPTH_LIMIT.note: LOCAL TEST ONLY: levels per side on the depth snapshot and deltas, so the book channel opens on the test stack (J-developer-09 #3, #5).

WS_MARKETS_LIST_LIMIT.note: LOCAL TEST ONLY: markets read from the listing per refresh.

WS_HIGH_WATER_BYTES.note: LOCAL TEST ONLY: 1 MiB outbound buffer per socket before a slow consumer is degraded.

WS_MAX_LAG_TICKS.note: LOCAL TEST ONLY: ticks a socket may stay over the buffer mark before it is closed.

WS_MAX_CONNECTIONS.note: LOCAL TEST ONLY: sockets per hub, far above what one journeys shard opens.

WS_MAX_NEW_CONNECTIONS_PER_MINUTE.note: LOCAL TEST ONLY: new sockets a minute, far above what one journeys shard opens.

WS_PRIVATE_MAX_CONNECTIONS_PER_USER.note: LOCAL TEST ONLY: private sockets one account may hold at once.

WS_HEARTBEAT_MS.note: LOCAL TEST ONLY: a ping every 2 seconds, so a client that stops answering is ended within seconds (J-developer-09 #4). The code default stays 30 seconds.

WS_TRADE_RECENT_LIMIT.note: LOCAL TEST ONLY: recent prints a trades subscriber gets first.

WS_DROP_COPY_RECENT_LIMIT.note: LOCAL TEST ONLY: recent fills a drop-copy subscriber gets first.

WS_MUX_MAX_SUBSCRIPTIONS.note: LOCAL TEST ONLY: channels one multiplexed socket may hold.

WS_MUX_MAX_OPS_PER_SECOND.note: LOCAL TEST ONLY: operations a second one multiplexed socket may send.

WS_MUX_MAX_SEATS.note: LOCAL TEST ONLY: multiplexed seats per hub.

WS_MUX_IDLE_MS.note: LOCAL TEST ONLY: a multiplexed socket holding no channel is closed after a minute, so the multiplexed door starts on the test stack (J-developer-09 #3, #5).
